summary: Appeal challenging default bail granted to accused in DHFL fraud case; investigation completed against 75 accused but continued against others; Section 167(2) Cr.P.C. statutory bail entitlement when chargesheet 'incomplete'; jurisdiction under Prevention of Corruption Act; Dinesh Dalmia precedent distinguished; Rakesh Kumar Paul principle applicable; Suresh Kumar Bhikamchand Jain cited; cognizance timing irrelevant to bail eligibility; piecemeal chargesheet invalidated.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.13(2), s.13(1)(d)
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of with direction to respondents to surrender within two weeks; default bail revoked.
